name: Dooly
gaps: Parcels are Dooly_County_Parcels — RVRC/SGRC FeatureServer (https://services1.arcgis.com/Ug5xGQbHsD8zuZzM/arcgis/rest/services/Dooly_County_Parcels/FeatureServer/14). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Household income stays the ACS B19013_001E tract join. GDOT AADT is not copied onto the parcel.
WinGAP a_value is stored as land value. It is not the 40 percent assessed amount, and mavcurr is empty, so assessed value stays blank.
Pass 2 tax is REST, sale is HTML-only, and owner is REST. HTML-only values were not scraped.
Pass 2 sale date and price are HTML-only and were not copied.
Property-appraiser links use each parcel id in the pass-2 template and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
